$comment: Allowlist of npm packages that user routes.js may require().
ONLY packages listed here are installable via the npm_install agent tool
and accepted by the install-runner-npms.ps1 server-side scanner.
- All packages are well-known, widely audited, and low supply-chain risk.
- On install, npm runs with --ignore-scripts to neuter postinstall RCE.
- The agent cannot install anything else; the shell tool blocks 'npm install'
1. Justify it (must be widely used, no install scripts when possible).
2. Pin a minVersion that's at least known-clean.
3. Add a short description so the agent knows when to use it.
4. Re-deploy install-runner-npms.ps1 + commit the allowlist together.

multer.description: Multipart form-data parser. Required for file uploads via the /bucket runner-side proxy.

axios.description: Promise-based HTTP client for outbound requests to public APIs (e.g. third-party data fetches).

node-fetch.description: Lightweight fetch() polyfill for routes.js. Most code can use globalThis.fetch directly; use this only when streaming a response body.

uuid.description: RFC4122 UUID generator. For idempotency keys, request IDs, etc.

nanoid.description: URL-safe random ID generator. Smaller than uuid, useful for short share-codes.

dayjs.description: Tiny date utility. Use this instead of moment for parsing/formatting dates.

zod.description: Schema validation. Useful for validating req.body shape before persisting.

lodash.clonedeep.description: Deep-clone helper. Single-purpose, smaller than full lodash.

mime-types.description: MIME type lookups for serving uploaded files.

sharp.description: Image processor (resize, format-convert). Native binary; install-time can be slow.

qrcode.description: QR code generator. Useful for share / referral links.

jsonwebtoken.description: JWT signing/verification. Use for inter-service tokens; do NOT roll your own crypto.

marked.description: Markdown → HTML renderer. Sanitize output before injecting into the DOM.

papaparse.description: Robust CSV parser. Use for CSV import/export features.

@ton/core.description: TON blockchain core primitives (Address, Cell, Builder, etc.). Required for any TON-related backend logic.

@ton/crypto.description: TON cryptographic helpers (key generation, signing). Companion to @ton/core.

@ton/ton.description: High-level TON client (TonClient4, WalletContractV4, etc.). Use for sending transactions and querying the chain.

express.description: Web framework. Only needed if a routes.js builds a sub-router with express.Router(); prefer the built-in req/res API otherwise.

form-data.description: Construct multipart/form-data payloads for outbound HTTP requests (e.g. uploading files to external APIs).

node-telegram-bot-api.description: Telegram Bot API client. Use when a project needs to send Telegram messages from its backend.

telegraf.description: Telegram bot framework (middleware-based). Alternative to node-telegram-bot-api for more complex bot logic.

rss-parser.description: RSS/Atom feed parser. Use for fetching and parsing news or content feeds.

pg.description: PostgreSQL client. Use when a project needs its own separate database (not the platform DB).

bcryptjs.description: Password hashing (bcrypt, pure JS). Use for hashing user passwords in project-specific auth systems.

pdfkit.description: PDF document generation. Use for creating invoices, reports, or any printable documents.

bip39.description: BIP39 mnemonic generation and validation. Use for TON/crypto wallet creation flows.

ethers.description: Ethereum/EVM library. Use for projects that interact with Ethereum-compatible chains.

@google/generative-ai.description: Google Gemini AI SDK. Use when a project needs AI text/image generation via a user-supplied Gemini API key.
